name: Dual Chroma
source:
For centuries after the Ashen War, the Empire has lived in peace under the protective power of the reigning Galens line. Tales of the dark era—of vile monsters and the heroes that vanquished them—fell into legend… until now.

Immerse yourself in the world of Dual Chroma as the bright young scholar, assuming their new role as advisor to Prince Keldrannon. When ancient forces long-thought to be vanquished threaten once again, it falls to you to work together with the Prince to save the Empire. Just how far does your connection to the Prince run? Will unearthing the secrets of the past and surviving the schemes of the Imperial Court allow you to stand by Keldran's side and win his heart—or will you fall victim to the clutches of the 'forgotten' great evil?

Your decisions will shape your shared destiny—and the fate of the continent of Aradal—forever.

[from [url=https://galengames.itch.io/dual-chroma]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
灰烬战争后的数百年间，帝国在加伦斯王朝的力量庇护下，一直安享和平。关于黑暗时代的故事——邪恶的怪物，以及消灭它们的英雄——都已沦为传说…直到如今。

走进《Dual Chroma》的世界，扮演才华横溢的年轻学者，履新担任凯尔德兰农王子的顾问。当那些早被认为已经消灭的古老力量再次构成威胁时，你必须与王子携手，拯救帝国。你与王子的羁绊究竟有多深？揭开往昔的秘密，在宫廷的阴谋中生存，你能否站在凯尔德兰身边，赢得他的心？还是会落入那位“被遗忘”的大恶人的魔爪？

你的决定，将永远改变两人共同的命运，以及阿拉达尔大陆的未来。

[摘自[url=https://galengames.itch.io/dual-chroma]itch.io[/url]]
